# Sognia — public legal documents

The published privacy policy, terms, account-deletion disclosure, community
guidelines, AI notice and 18+ notice for **Sognia**, in English, Turkish and
Spanish.

**Do not edit these files by hand.** They are GENERATED from the documents the
app itself renders in-app, by `tool/build_legal_pages.py` in the Sognia
application repository. Editing here would silently make the website disagree
with what users read inside the app, which is the exact failure the generator
exists to prevent.

To change anything: edit the legal text in the app, re-run the generator, and
republish the output.

Contact: support@sognia.app
